about.title: I design, build and improve digital products for businesses.
about.p1: Most people either draw a site or code it. I also care about what happens after a visitor arrives from an ad or a search result — where attention goes, what is understood in the first five seconds, whether the next step is obvious.
about.p2: Business understanding, marketing thinking, design and frontend development in one head — plus access to deeper engineering when a project needs it.

faq.title: Still thinking? That's normal.
faq.lead: A website is a real investment. If your question is not here, just ask me directly.

price.q: How much does a website cost?
price.a: Landing pages start from 1 500 €, business sites from 2 500 €, custom applications are quoted per project. You get a fixed price before the work starts.

time.q: How long does a project take?
time.a: A landing page usually 2–3 weeks, a business site 4–6. Applications depend on scope.

scope.q: Do you handle both design and development?
scope.a: Yes — strategy, structure, design and build. For deeper engineering I bring in trusted specialists and remain your point of contact.

existing.q: Can you take over an existing project?
existing.a: Yes — a builder site, old code or work left by another developer. I review it first and say honestly whether to improve, rebuild or extend.

ownership.a: Fully. Domain, hosting and all files are in your name, with access handed over at launch.

ads.q: Can it be used with Google or Meta Ads?
ads.a: That is how it is planned from the start: clear offer, fast load, analytics and lead events ready for traffic.
